svg.title: Circular economy reduces final energy demand and changes the fuel mix

cc:Work.dc:title: Circular economy reduces final energy demand and changes the fuel mix
cc:Work.dc:description: Global final energy demand in 2050 for cement, iron and steel, and aluminium. Rows distinguish Baseline and NDC climate-policy cases; bars distinguish the five CE settings. Segment colours identify exact parent energy-carrier categories. Nested fuel subcategories are excluded to prevent double counting. Cement has four reported carrier categories; steel and aluminium also include hydrogen. Labels give the percentage change in each sector's total final energy relative to no CE under the same climate pathway. The same y-axis scale is used within each sector across both rows, while sectors have different scales. EU+ means EU plus international partners.
